description: List the account's videos that had NO access at all in a period (the inverse of the ranking). Whole account only. Only videos that already existed on start_date are considered. Returns {start_date, end_date, data: [{id, video_external_id, title, created_at}], pagination: {limit, offset, total_unwatched, has_more}, coverage: {partial_coverage, missing_days}} — when partial_coverage is true, a listed video may have had access on the missing days.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days ago — always sent, since the API returns partial data without it.

name: panda_get_unwatched_videos
title: Get Unwatched Videos
